traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τὸ ῥῆμα ·
traditions.VUL: Et renuntiavérunt regi quod díxerat .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַ֖ח הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς
traditions.VUL: Qui misit :
traditions.KJV: And the king sent ,

1.english_reference: and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּאַסְפ֣וּ אֵלָ֔י ו כָּל זִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνήγαγεν πρὸς ἑαυτὸν πάντας τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους Ἰούδα καὶ Ἰερουσαλήμ
traditions.VUL: et congregáti sunt ad eum omnes senes Iuda et Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem .

2.english_reference: And the king went up into the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֣עַל הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית יְהוָ֡ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέβη ὁ βασιλεὺς εἰς οἶκον Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Ascendítque rex templum Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: And the king went up into the house of the LORD ,

2.english_reference: and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָה֩ וְ כָל יֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אִתּ֗ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ πᾶς ἀνὴρ Ἰούδα καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: et omnes viri Iuda , universíque qui habitábant in Ierúsalem cum eo
traditions.KJV: and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him ,

2.english_reference: and the priests , and the prophets , and all the people , both small and great

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְ הַ נְּבִיאִ֔ים וְ כָל הָ עָ֖ם לְ מִ קָּטֹ֣ן וְ עַד גָּד֑וֹל
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ προφῆται καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἀπὸ μικροῦ καὶ ἕως μεγάλου ,
traditions.VUL: sacerdótes et prophétæ , et omnis pópulus a parvo usque ad magnum :
traditions.KJV: and the priests , and the prophets , and all the people , both small and great :

2.english_reference: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרָ֣א בְ אָזְנֵי הֶ֗ם אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַ בְּרִ֔ית הַ נִּמְצָ֖א בְּ בֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέγνω ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν πάντας τοὺς λόγους τοῦ βιβλίου τῆς διαθήκης τοῦ εὑρεθέντος ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: legítque cunctis audiéntibus ómnia verba libri fœ́deris , qui invéntus est in domo Dómini .
traditions.KJV: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD .

3.english_reference: And the king stood by a pillar

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲמֹ֣ד הַ֠ מֶּלֶךְ עַֽל הָ֨ עַמּ֜וּד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστη ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς τὸν στύλον ,
traditions.VUL: Stetítque rex super gradum :
traditions.KJV: And the king stood by a pillar ,

3.english_reference: and made a covenant before the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּכְרֹ֥ת אֶֽת הַ בְּרִ֣ית לִ פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ διέθετο διαθήκην ἐνώπιον Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: et fœdus percússit coram Dómino ,
traditions.KJV: and made a covenant before the LORD ,

3.english_reference: to walk after the LORD , and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all [ their ] heart and all [ their ] soul

traditions.WLC: לָ לֶ֜כֶת אַחַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ וְ לִ שְׁמֹ֨ר מִצְוֺתָ֜י ו וְ אֶת עֵדְוֺתָ֤י ו וְ אֶת חֻקֹּתָי ו֙ בְּ כָל לֵ֣ב וּ בְ כָל נֶ֔פֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: τοῦ πορεύεσθαι ὀπίσω Κυρίου , τοῦ φυλάσσειν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ μαρτύρια αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ ἐν πάσῃ καρδίᾳ καὶ ἐν πάσῃ ψυχῇ ,
traditions.VUL: ut ambulárent post Dóminum , et custodírent præcépta eius , et testimónia , et cæremónias in omni corde , et in tota ánima ,
traditions.KJV: to walk after the LORD , and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all [ their ] heart and all [ their ] soul ,

3.english_reference: to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book

traditions.WLC: לְ הָקִ֗ים אֶת דִּבְרֵי֙ הַ בְּרִ֣ית הַ זֹּ֔את הַ כְּתֻבִ֖ים עַל הַ סֵּ֣פֶר הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: τοῦ ἀναστῆσαι τοὺς λόγους τῆς διαθήκης ταύτης , τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐπὶ τὸ βιβλίον τοῦτο ·
traditions.VUL: et suscitárent verba fœ́deris huius , quæ scripta erant in libro illo :
traditions.KJV: to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book .

3.english_reference: And all the people stood to the covenant

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲמֹ֥ד כָּל הָ עָ֖ם בַּ בְּרִֽית
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστη πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἐν τῇ διαθήκῃ
traditions.VUL: acquievítque pópulus pacto .
traditions.KJV: And all the people stood to the covenant .

4.english_reference: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest , and the priests of the second order , and the keepers of the door

traditions.WLC: וַ יְצַ֣ו הַ מֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת חִלְקִיָּהוּ֩ הַ כֹּהֵ֨ן הַ גָּד֜וֹל וְ אֶת כֹּהֲנֵ֣י הַ מִּשְׁנֶה֮ וְ אֶת שֹׁמְרֵ֣י הַ סַּף֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνετείλατο ὁ βασιλεὺς τῷ Χελκείᾳ τῷ ἱερεῖ τῷ μεγάλῳ καὶ τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν τῆς δευτερώσεως καὶ τοῖς φυλάσσουσιν τὸν σταθμὸν
traditions.VUL: Et præcépit rex Helcíæ pontífici , et sacerdótibus secúndi órdinis , et ianitóribus ,
traditions.KJV: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest , and the priests of the second order , and the keepers of the door ,

4.english_reference: to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal , and for the grove , and for all the host of heaven

traditions.WLC: לְ הוֹצִיא֙ מֵ הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ כֵּלִ֗ים הָֽ עֲשׂוּיִם֙ לַ בַּ֣עַל וְ לָֽ אֲשֵׁרָ֔ה וּ לְ כֹ֖ל צְבָ֣א הַ שָּׁמָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: ἐξαγαγεῖν ἐκ τοῦ ναοῦ Κυρίου πάντα τὰ σκεύη τὰ πεποιημένα τῷ Βάαλ καὶ τῷ ἄλσει καὶ πάσῃ τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: ut proícerent de templo Dómini ómnia vasa , quæ facta fúerant Baal , et in luco , et univérsæ milítiæ cæli :
traditions.KJV: to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal , and for the grove , and for all the host of heaven :

4.english_reference: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּשְׂרְפֵ֞ ם מִ ח֤וּץ לִ ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ בְּ שַׁדְמ֣וֹת קִדְר֔וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέκαυσεν αὐτὰ ἔξω Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐν σαλημὼθ Κεδρών ,
traditions.VUL: et combússit ea foris Ierúsalem in conválle Cedron ,
traditions.KJV: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron ,

4.english_reference: and carried the ashes of them unto Bethel

traditions.WLC: וְ נָשָׂ֥א אֶת עֲפָרָ֖ ם בֵּֽית אֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν τὸν χοῦν αὐτῶν εἰς Βαιθήλ
traditions.VUL: et tulit púlverem eórum in Bethel .
traditions.KJV: and carried the ashes of them unto Bethel .

5.english_reference: And he put down the idolatrous priests , whom the kings of Judah had ordained

traditions.WLC: וְ הִשְׁבִּ֣ית אֶת הַ כְּמָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽתְנוּ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέκαυσεν τοὺς χωμαρεὶμ οὓς ἔδωκαν βασιλεῖ Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: Et delévit arúspices , quos posúerant reges Iuda
traditions.KJV: And he put down the idolatrous priests , whom the kings of Judah had ordained

5.english_reference: to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah , and in the places round about Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ יְקַטֵּ֤ר בַּ בָּמוֹת֙ בְּ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ מְסִבֵּ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐθυμίων ἐν τοῖς ὑψηλοῖς καὶ ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν Ἰούδα καὶ τοῖς περικύκλῳ Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: ad sacrificándum in excélsis per civitátes Iuda , et in circúitu Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah , and in the places round about Jerusalem ;

5.english_reference: them also that burned incense unto Baal , to the sun , and to the moon , and to the planets , and to all the host of heaven

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת הַֽ מְקַטְּרִ֣ים לַ בַּ֗עַל לַ שֶּׁ֤מֶשׁ וְ לַ יָּרֵ֨חַ֙ וְ לַ מַּזָּל֔וֹת וּ לְ כֹ֖ל צְבָ֥א הַ שָּׁמָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς θυμιῶντας τῷ Βάαλ καὶ τῷ ἡλίῳ καὶ τῇ σελήνῃ καὶ τοῖς μαζουρὼθ καὶ πάσῃ τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ οὐρανοῦ
traditions.VUL: et eos , qui adolébant incénsum Baal , et soli , et lunæ , et duódecim signis , et omni milítiæ cæli .
traditions.KJV: them also that burned incense unto Baal , to the sun , and to the moon , and to the planets , and to all the host of heaven .

6.english_reference: And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD , without Jerusalem , unto the brook Kidron

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּצֵ֣א אֶת הָ אֲשֵׁרָה֩ מִ בֵּ֨ית יְהוָ֜ה מִ ח֤וּץ לִ ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אֶל נַ֣חַל קִדְר֔וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξήνεγκεν τὸ ἄλσος ἐξ οἴκου Κυρίου ἔξωθεν Ἰερουσαλὴμ εἰς τὸν χειμάρρουν Κεδρών ,
traditions.VUL: Et efférri fecit lucum de domo Dómini foras Ierúsalem in conválle Cedron ,
traditions.KJV: And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD , without Jerusalem , unto the brook Kidron ,

6.english_reference: and burned it at the brook Kidron

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׂרֹ֥ף אֹתָ֛ הּ בְּ נַ֥חַל קִדְר֖וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέκαυσεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ χειμάρρῳ Κεδρὼν
traditions.VUL: et combússit eum ibi ,
traditions.KJV: and burned it at the brook Kidron ,

6.english_reference: and stamped [ it ] small to powder

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֣דֶק לְ עָפָ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐλέπτυνεν εἰς χοῦν ,
traditions.VUL: et redégit in púlverem ,
traditions.KJV: and stamped [ it ] small to powder ,

6.english_reference: and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶת עֲפָרָ֔ הּ עַל קֶ֖בֶר בְּנֵ֥י הָ עָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔριψεν τὸν χοῦν αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν τάφον τῶν υἱῶν τοῦ λαοῦ
traditions.VUL: et proiécit super sepúlcra vulgi .
traditions.KJV: and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people .

7.english_reference: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites , that [ were ] by the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֹּץ֙ אֶת בָּתֵּ֣י הַ קְּדֵשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ καθεῖλεν τὸν οἶκον τῶν καδησεὶμ τῶν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Destrúxit quoque ædículas effeminatórum , quæ erant in domo Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites , that [ were ] by the house of the LORD ,

7.english_reference: where the women wove hangings for the grove

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר הַ נָּשִׁ֗ים אֹרְג֥וֹת שָׁ֛ם בָּתִּ֖ים לָ אֲשֵׁרָֽה
traditions.LXX: οὗ αἱ γυναῖκες ὕφαινον ἐκεῖ χεττιεὶν τῷ ἄλσει
traditions.VUL: pro quibus mulíeres texébant quasi domúnculas luci .
traditions.KJV: where the women wove hangings for the grove .

8.english_reference: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֵ֤א אֶת כָּל הַ כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ מֵ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνήγαγεν πάντας τοὺς ἱερεῖς ἐκ πόλεων Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: Congregavítque omnes sacerdótes de civitátibus Iuda :
traditions.KJV: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah ,

8.english_reference: and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense , from Geba to Beersheba

traditions.WLC: וַ יְטַמֵּ֣א אֶת הַ בָּמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִטְּרוּ שָׁ֨מָּ ה֙ הַ כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מִ גֶּ֖בַע עַד בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐμίανεν τὰ ὑψηλὰ οὗ ἐθυμίασαν ἐκεῖ οἱ ἱερεῖς ἀπὸ Γαιβὰλ καὶ ἕως Βηρσάβεε ·
traditions.VUL: et contaminávit excélsa ubi sacrificábant sacerdótes de Gábaa usque Bersabée :
traditions.KJV: and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense , from Geba to Beersheba ,

8.english_reference: and brake down the high places of the gates that [ were ] in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city , which [ were ] on a man ’s left hand at the gate of the city

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַ֞ץ אֶת בָּמ֣וֹת הַ שְּׁעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר פֶּ֜תַח שַׁ֤עַר יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ שַׂר הָ עִ֔יר אֲשֶֽׁר עַל שְׂמֹ֥אול אִ֖ישׁ בְּ שַׁ֥עַר הָ עִֽיר
traditions.LXX: καὶ καθεῖλεν τὸν οἶκον τῶν πυλῶν τὸν παρὰ τὴν θύραν τῆς πύλης Ἰησοῦ ἄρχοντος τῆς πύλης , τῶν ἐξ ἀριστερῶν ἀνδρὸς ἐν τῇ πύλῃ τῆς πόλεως
traditions.VUL: et destrúxit aras portárum in intróitu óstii Iósue príncipis civitátis , quod erat ad sinístram portæ civitátis .
traditions.KJV: and brake down the high places of the gates that [ were ] in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city , which [ were ] on a man ’s left hand at the gate of the city .

9.english_reference: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: אַ֗ךְ לֹ֤א יַֽעֲלוּ֙ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י הַ בָּמ֔וֹת אֶל מִזְבַּ֥ח יְהוָ֖ה בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: πλὴν οὐκ ἀνέβησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς τῶν ὑψηλῶν πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον Κυρίου ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: Verúmtamen non ascendébant sacerdótes excelsórum ad altáre Dómini in Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem ,

9.english_reference: but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren

traditions.WLC: כִּ֛י אִם אָכְל֥וּ מַצּ֖וֹת בְּ ת֥וֹךְ אֲחֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι εἰ μὴ ἔφαγον ἄζυμα ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν
traditions.VUL: sed tantum comedébant ázyma in médio fratrum suórum .
traditions.KJV: but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren .

10.english_reference: And he defiled Topheth , which [ is ] in the valley of the children of Hinnom

traditions.WLC: וְ טִמֵּ֣א אֶת הַ תֹּ֔פֶת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ גֵ֣י בני הִנֹּ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ μιανεῖτε τὸν Τάφεθ ἐν φάραγγι υἱοῦ Ἑννόμ ,
traditions.VUL: Contaminávit quoque Topheth , quod est in conválle fílii Ennom :
traditions.KJV: And he defiled Topheth , which [ is ] in the valley of the children of Hinnom ,

10.english_reference: that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech

traditions.WLC: לְ בִלְתִּ֗י לְ הַעֲבִ֨יר אִ֜ישׁ אֶת בְּנ֧ וֹ וְ אֶת בִּתּ֛ וֹ בָּ אֵ֖שׁ לַ מֹּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: τοῦ διαγαγεῖν ἄνδρα τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἄνδρα τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ τῷ Μόλοχ ἐν πυρί
traditions.VUL: ut nemo consecráret fílium suum aut fíliam per ignem , Moloch .
traditions.KJV: that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech .

11.english_reference: And he took away the horses

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּשְׁבֵּ֣ת אֶת הַ סּוּסִ֗ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέκαυσεν τοὺς ἵππους
traditions.VUL: Abstulit quoque equos ,
traditions.KJV: And he took away the horses

11.english_reference: that the kings of Judah had given to the sun

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנוּ֩ מַלְכֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֤ה לַ שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙
traditions.LXX: οὓς ἔδωκαν βασιλεῖς Ἰούδα τῷ ἡλίῳ
traditions.VUL: quos déderant reges Iuda Soli ,
traditions.KJV: that the kings of Judah had given to the sun ,
